name: NATGATE
recent: NationGate 近期被纳入 MSCI Malaysia Small Cap Index，并宣布进军光网络业务；同时董事与主要股东在 8 月至 9 月间因 Share Grant 归属而出现股权变动，公司也回购库存股。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收同比下滑 32.1%，净利同比减少 79.1%，但环比大幅回升。
notable: 公司被纳入 MSCI Malaysia Small Cap Index。
公司宣布转向光网络（optical networking）业务。
公司宣派 2026 财年中期单层股息每股 0.25 仙。
risks: 董事与主要股东在 8 月至 9 月间多次因 Share Grant 归属而申报股权变动。
公司多次回购库存股，导致库存股数量变动。
最新季度营收与净利同比均大幅下滑。
earnings: 2026-06-30 季度营收为 MYR 1,768.93 million，同比下滑 32.1%，环比增长 2.8%；净利为 MYR 10.904 million，同比减少 79.1%，环比大增 2,029.7%；净利率 0.6%。

recent_en: NationGate was recently added to the MSCI Malaysia Small Cap Index and announced a move into optical networking; meanwhile, directors and a substantial shareholder saw shareholding changes in August-September from vesting of Share Grants, and the company bought back treasury shares. In the latest quarter (2026-06-30), revenue fell 32.1% YoY and net profit dropped 79.1% YoY, though both improved sharply QoQ.
notable_en: The company was added to the MSCI Malaysia Small Cap Index.
The company announced a shift into optical networking.
The company declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.25 sen per share for FY2026.
risks_en: Directors and a substantial shareholder filed multiple shareholding changes in August-September due to vesting of Share Grants.
The company made several treasury share buybacks, changing its treasury share count.
Latest quarterly revenue and net profit both fell sharply YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 1,768.93 million, down 32.1% YoY but up 2.8% QoQ; net profit was MYR 10.904 million, down 79.1% YoY but up 2,029.7% QoQ; net margin was 0.6%.
